name: is-typo
description:
true for a phrase with a misspelt word, false for the others.

By default the words are learnt from the phrases given, so give the whole core: a word is misspelt when another word stands in at least 10 times as many phrases and differs from it by a few edits (up to 2, and one per two letters after the first for a short word: «диавн» → «диван»). A word with a digit, a stopword and a wordform the bundled dictionary or pymorphy3 knows («москве», «угловые») are never misspelt; a correction starts with the same letter as the word.

The step writes its result to a new column <column>_typo.

Example: semkit read core.csv is-typo write out.csv

options.name: --as
options.description: Write the result to a new column NAME and keep the working column as it is.
